before_conditions: A BuilderWallet has been deployed by BuilderFactory
The BuilderWallet holds ERC20 tokens (e.g., builder fee/commission receipts)
The attacker is unprivileged (not the intended builderAdmin)
required_property: BuilderWallet.init() should be callable only once, so that the builderAdmin role cannot be reassigned after the factory's initial initialization, protecting the wallet's admin role and its held ERC20 tokens from any unprivileged party at all times after deployment
bad_outcome: The attacker becomes builderAdmin of the deployed BuilderWallet and can call sweep(token, attacker) to steal all ERC20 tokens held by that wallet
